about.title: A home for childhood in Teboulba
about.lead: ONET Teboulba is the local branch of the Tunisian National Children's Organisation. Volunteers, monitors and families support children and youth so they grow up happy, curious and responsible.
about.mission: To give every child, whatever their background, a safe space to learn, play, discover, take part and belong to a community.

safety.title: Safety & care
safety.text: Monitors trained in first aid and youth work, a reassuring setting for families.

rights.title: Children's rights
rights.text: Every child is listened to, respected and encouraged to speak up.

inclusion.title: Open to all
inclusion.text: Accessible activities, fair fees and a place for everyone.

joy.title: Joy & creativity
joy.text: We learn best by having fun: games, songs, arts and big adventures.

about.groupsSubtitle: Children are welcomed by age group, with dedicated monitors.
about.history: Since {year}, the Teboulba Children's House has welcomed generations of kids. What began as a few Saturday clubs became a place where we sing, create, travel and grow together.

join.title: Become a member
join.subtitle: ONET Teboulba's members are its animators: young people and adults who give their time to children. Create your account, the association approves it and you join the team.
join.who: Anyone aged 12 and over, at school, studying, working or not, who wants to lead activities, sing, play and share with Teboulba's children.
